comment.comment:
To the $BUCKME community 🦌

Buck Me is a community takeover. That means no dev is carrying this. We are.

Here's a story I lived this month. For four weeks I followed one of the biggest names in crypto as he talked about his project: how you build it, how he was investing back into it, how it was for the long run. I believed it. I put some of my own money in. Then he pulled out.

That's the story of meme coins. Devs and influencers build hype, farm the people who trust them, and exit with the liquidity. It's toxic, and it's why most people lose.

We can change this.

There's only one way that has ever worked: find a project you believe in, get in on the ground floor, hold, and build it with the community. It takes time, patience, and real people doing the work.

That's why I'm here. Not for a quick flip, but because of you, the people who want to see this succeed.

So when you tell someone about Buck Me, tell them this:
👉 We're here to change the toxic culture of meme coins.
👉 No one is going to farm this community. We build it together.
👉 We lean on each other, we stay patient, and we keep building.

Every project that has lasted was built this way. Let's enjoy the process of building something real, together.

This is our story. Let's go write it. 🚀

#BUCKME
